actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm exec commitlint --edit /app/.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG
actions.description: Validate commit message format against Conventional Commits standard

actions.action: docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --diff --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php --dry-run
actions.description: Check for styling issues with PHP-CS-Fixer (Dry-Run)

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep .php$ | xargs -r -I {} docker compose exec -T php php -l /var/www/html/{}
actions.description: Check for basic PHP syntax errors (Linting)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm exec prettier --check 'src/**/*.{ts,js,json}'
actions.description: Check Node.js code formatting with Prettier

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm exec eslint 'src/**/*.{ts,js}' --max-warnings=0
actions.description: Lint Node.js code with ESLint (TypeScript-aware, zero warnings)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm run type-check
actions.description: Check TypeScript types (similar to PHPStan for type safety)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan.neon --memory-limit=1G
actions.description: Run PHPStan static analysis (Level 5) before pushing to remote

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm test
actions.description: Run Vitest tests (Node.js unit & integration tests)
